title: Origin story: Amaterasu
description: Amaterasu was born from the left eye of Izanagi as he purified himself after returning from the underworld. She became ruler of the Plain of High Heaven, and when her brother Susanoo's rampage drove her to hide in a cave, the other gods lured her out with laughter and dance, restoring light to the world.

title: Stamina feats: Amaterasu
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Endured Susanoo's desecration without abandoning heaven; Shines daily since the world's beginning.
